findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Weak cryptographic algorithms
 * @description Use of weak cryptographic algorithms like MD5, SHA1
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/weak-crypto
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of weak cryptographic hash function (MD5 or SHA1) for security-sensitive operations"
findings.hypothesis: Weak cryptographic algorithms (MD5, SHA1) used for security-sensitive operations
